title: Learning Counterfactual World Models for Embodied Reasoning under Partial Observability
abstract: arXiv:2609.05834v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models promise a general route to embodied intelligence: learn predictive dynamics once, then reason, plan, and act with them. Increasingly, the representations beneath such models are pretrained on large-scale video, interaction, and multimodal corpora, which raises a question prediction quality alone cannot answer: when is a learned representation actually actionable? We identify a failure mode we call counterfactual collapse: a model predicts visually plausible futures while failing to distinguish interventions with different behavioral consequences. This arises whenever a representation is optimized for perceptual similarity rather than intervention structure, which is precisely the objective under which most large-scale pretrained encoders are learned. translated_title: 在部分可观测性下学习反事实世界模型以支持具身推理
translated_abstract: 世界模型为具身智能提供了一条通用的路径：只需学习一次预测性动力学，便可用其进行推理、规划与行动。这类模型底层的表征越来越多地在大规模视频、交互与多模态语料上进行预训练，由此引出了一个仅凭预测质量无法回答的问题：习得的表征何时才真正具有可操作性？我们发现了一种称之为“反事实坍塌”的失效模式：模型能够预测出视觉上合理的未来，却无法区分具有不同行为后果的干预。只要表征是以感知相似性而非干预结构为优化目标，这种失效便会出现，而这恰恰是大多数大规模预训练编码器所采用的学习目标。我们提出了反事实潜在世界模型（CLWM），它结合了循环信念状态编码器、动作条件化的潜在动力学以及对比反事实目标
tldr: 提出反事实潜在世界模型（CLWM），利用对比反事实目标解决世界模型“预测视觉合理却无法区分不同行为后果干预”的反事实坍塌问题，使习得表征在部分可观测的具身环境中真正具备可操作性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Counterfactual Latent World Models (CLWM), which employ a contrastive counterfactual objective to overcome "counterfactual collapse"—where world models yield visually plausible predictions yet fail to distinguish interventions with different behavioral consequences—making learned representations truly actionable for embodied reasoning under partial observability.
